services.name: Private Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Are you on Maui to celebrate a special occasion? This is the experience for you! Times and duration Daily 2 hour trips available weather permitting May 15th to October 15th – 4:30pm October 16th to May 14th – 4:00pm Check in 15-20 minutes prior to charter About You will cruise along the beautiful Maui coastline watching the sun sink to the west and light up the beautiful island landscape to the east. It is truly a magnificent time to explore Maui's waters. Note: During whale season (Dec. 15 to Mar. 31) you will also have the opportunity to view majestic humpbacks in south Maui waters. For an additional fee, we would gladly organize a special catering menu to help celebrate any occasion.
